d: Diwali is the season of sweets, snacks and festive feasts. But what if the food you bring home is not what it claims to be? From fake ghee and adulterated paneer to unsafe sweets, food authorities across India are making alarming discoveries. So, what exactly is going into your food? Why does adulteration spike during festivals? And how can you spot the warning signs before you take that first bite? Palki Sharma tells you.
